safe_sentence: Large pools of capital are moving through distinct financial wrappers into identifiable real-economy borrowers, assets, projects, collateral pools, and operating systems.
evidence_basis: Meta-question matrix; detailed answers dossier; claim dashboard; evidence ledger; answer-status dashboard.
caveat: The full source-to-use-to-output-to-bank-role chain is proven only in pieces.
next_proof_needed: Source-of-capital decomposition, facility-size reconstruction, use-of-proceeds documents, bank-role proof, and operating-conversion scorecards.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when source, vehicle, borrower/company, use, output, bank role, and denominator align for repeated cases.
do_not_say: Do not say the whole thesis is fully proven across sectors.

safe_sentence: Capital is visibly reaching private-credit borrowers, power/grid assets, energy infrastructure, fleet and collateral pools, backlog execution, acquisition finance, and sponsor-backed operating platforms.
evidence_basis: Ares borrower holder expansion; capital-intensive funding map; URI and Sterling passes; power/grid and energy source rows.
caveat: Exact use split remains incomplete across productive capacity, acquisition, refinancing, liquidity, and control transfer.
next_proof_needed: Classify each destination row by use-of-proceeds and operating output.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when each destination has same-period amount, source, use, and output metric.
do_not_say: Do not turn every funded exposure into new productive capacity.

safe_sentence: Visible wrappers include BDCs, insurers, retirement-linked platforms, public debt investors, ABL and AR lenders, private-credit funds, and bank facilities.
evidence_basis: Vehicle taxonomy; source-to-vehicle bridge; BDC funding-stack extractions; insurance platform extractions.
caveat: Ultimate investor or liability source is not tied to most named borrower rows in the same period.
next_proof_needed: Vehicle capital-stack decomposition for public BDCs and non-traded/private-credit vehicles.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when same-period vehicle funding stack and borrower holding are both visible.
do_not_say: Do not say a holder vehicle proves the ultimate money source.

safe_sentence: The visible Ares borrower holder layer now classifies public BDCs, non-traded BDC/private-credit funds, registered funds, private funds, direct-lending programs, and transaction-context sources.
evidence_basis: 83-row holder expansion; 16-row vehicle taxonomy; source-to-vehicle bridge.
caveat: Vehicle identity is stronger than ultimate source-of-capital proof.
next_proof_needed: Funding-stack decomposition by vehicle and reporting period.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when vehicle type, manager, funding stack, liabilities, NAV/equity, leverage, and investor base are visible.
do_not_say: Do not equate vehicle classification with full source allocation.

safe_sentence: Private-credit borrower flows are mixed: acquisition finance, consolidation support, continued-growth facilities, incremental commitments, transaction-only leads, and selected bank-credit repayment or termination are all visible.
evidence_basis: 12-row use-of-proceeds classification pass; bank-role pass; answer-resolution queue.
caveat: Organic capex and new productive capacity are not the default conclusion for every borrower.
next_proof_needed: Credit agreements, merger proxies, sponsor releases, funds-flow language, acquisition timelines, and borrower KPIs.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when a named amount is tied to exact use and borrower event.
do_not_say: Do not say every private-credit dollar funds organic growth.

safe_sentence: Specific borrower-level bank-facility takeout can be proven in selected cases, while broad bank replacement remains unproven.
evidence_basis: Auctane/Stamps.com termination evidence; Medallia repayment evidence; Atwell unresolved bank-facility test; Guidehouse secondary bank-competition lead.
caveat: Banks may remain as revolver lenders, agents, hedging providers, treasury providers, collateral-facility lenders, or other ancillary providers.
next_proof_needed: Pre/post lender maps, payoff notices, UCC amendments, credit agreements, rating reports, and bank denominators.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade only when prior bank facility status and new private-credit role are both visible.
do_not_say: Do not say private credit is broadly replacing banks.

safe_sentence: Platform AUM and deployment prove scale; BDC schedules and borrower crosswalks prove named exposure; they are different evidence levels.
evidence_basis: Meta-question matrix; detailed proof-task table; Ares holder expansion; promoted claims register.
caveat: Platform pools cannot be allocated to named borrowers without a bridge.
next_proof_needed: Same-period vehicle, borrower, instrument, facility, and source evidence.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when platform, vehicle, borrower, period, instrument, and amount all line up.
do_not_say: Do not use AUM or deployment as borrower allocation proof.

safe_sentence: Audit rows, same-period borrower controls, and master-rollup promoted totals are separate and should be used for different claims.
evidence_basis: 83-row Ares expansion; 9-row same-period borrower summary; master borrower exposure rollup.
caveat: The control must be reused across future lanes and external writing.
next_proof_needed: Reusable aggregation-control standard and claim-specific permitted-use fields.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when every promoted number carries period, row-type, duplicate, and permitted-use controls.
do_not_say: Do not sum mixed-period, comparative, locator, transaction-only, and derived rows as current exposure.

safe_sentence: URI is now a repeated-period fleet capital-to-output proxy case, Sterling is now a conversion-supported backlog/acquisition execution platform, and ET/Cheniere have bounded company/entity/physical-output evidence; grid/power still needs project-level output linkage.
evidence_basis: URI operating conversion scorecard; Sterling backlog credit-platform conversion pass; ET/Cheniere energy project source-use-return pass; capital-intensive source-table, denominator, and project-funding passes.
caveat: Direct source-to-specific-output linkage remains incomplete for most lanes; ET/Cheniere still lack complete project-level source-of-funds, use-of-proceeds, customer economics, cash return, and waterfall proof.
next_proof_needed: Publication-ready claim register; grid/power conversion scorecards; Sterling project/customer funding bridge and post-reset credit/L/C usage bridge; ET/Cheniere project registry by asset/train.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when named funded period links to sustained revenue, utilization, cash conversion, rate-base, MW, cargo, backlog burn, or project-specific output evidence.
do_not_say: Do not treat capex, backlog, AUM, funding capacity, L/C capacity, revolver size, or cargo counts as full project return proof by itself.

safe_sentence: The 519-company universe now has a role/wrapper/proof extraction template that routes every company into a lane, expected funding wrapper, source-availability status, proof level, denominator need, next-document target, safe claim, and do-not-claim boundary.
evidence_basis: 519-company triage; lane candidate queues; all-company scale-up operating model; all-company extraction template; evidence ledger.
caveat: Most rows remain radar, high-signal backlog, or lane-queue status until primary-source extraction is run.
next_proof_needed: Run lane-specific extraction batches from the template and refresh proof levels after each source pass.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when every company has source-backed role, wrapper, evidence, denominator, and safe-claim status rather than template-grade status.
do_not_say: Do not treat the 519-company template as source proof or representative completion of the thesis.

safe_sentence: The five-company debt/refinancing lane now has bounded follow-through bridges: Wheaton is company-level stream funding, Matador is borrowing-base source/use/output, Liberty Broadband is holdco collateral restructuring, PBF is refining liquidity, and Devon is merger-period allocation.
evidence_basis: Debt/refinancing use-return frontier; Wheaton Antamina bridge; Matador borrowing-base bridge; Liberty Broadband holdco bridge; PBF refining liquidity bridge; Devon merger-period allocation bridge.
caveat: None of the five proves asset-level return, stream-level return, project return, refinery-level return, shareholder realization, or dollar-level source/use allocation.
next_proof_needed: Treasury funds-flow, lender allocation, facility-size reconstruction, covenant/pricing detail, asset-level output/cash, realized synergy, and debt-service economics.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade when a row ties source, use, asset/project, output, cash return, and debt economics in the same period.
do_not_say: Do not convert company-level bridge evidence into asset-level return proof.
